slides.title: What does your friction do to the people across from you?

body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand. The overhook player has an overhook. The underhook player has an underhook.

Overhook player: keep the overhook, use both hands to move your partner, and make foot-to-foot contact with either leg. Underhook player: close your hands anywhere below the overhook player's elbows and above his ankles.

items: The overhook player wins when the underhook player falls to his hips or hands.
The underhook player wins by closing his hands under the elbows.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The top player stands. The bottom player sits on the mat with an inside hook and a knee-pit grip.

Bottom player: move from seated to belly up, using your connections to put the top player down on his hips or hands, then wrestle up or stand and make his back touch the mat. Top player: put the bottom player on his back and keep shin contact.

items: The bottom player wins by standing up and reaching the hips, or by making the top player's back touch the mat.
The top player wins with shin contact on the knees or body.

body.text: SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his back. The top player covers his head with a figure-four grip, one hand on the wrist, the other arm under the elbow.

Top player: keep the figure-four grip and stay under at least one elbow while keeping the bottom player pinned. Bottom player: break the grip by freeing your arms and getting your elbows to your body.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the grip.
The bottom player wins by breaking the grip.

slides.title: How you win it
slides.question: In Figure Four Grip Control Game, what wins it for the top player?

options.text: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the grip.
options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

options.text: Holding the finish after your partner taps
options.feedback: Never. Let go the instant your partner taps. Every single time. The tap is law.
You keep the pin by feeling your partner and moving with them, not by clamping down and squeezing hard. Staying calm beats forcing harder.

slides.correctText: That is how you win today.
